import hashlib,json,statistics
from pathlib import Path
import torch,torch_npu
from safetensors import safe_open
from tools.glm_perf.glm_int4 import pack_nz_codes,unpack_canonical_codes
from tools.glm_perf.glm_fused_moe import FusedGeometry,NativeFusedMoE

root=Path('/home/matteius/experiments/glm-reconstruction-20261006')
build=root/'build-native-fused-v13'
checkpoint=Path('/srv/ai/models/GLM-5.3-Flash-selective-W3-310p')
prefix='model.language_model.layers.11.mlp.experts.0.'
index=json.loads((checkpoint/'model.safetensors.index.json').read_text())['weight_map']
torch.npu.set_device(0)
torch_npu.npu.set_compile_mode(jit_compile=False)
torch.ops.load_library(str(build/'glm_reconstruction_bridge_v13.so'))
values=[]
for projection in ('gate','up','down'):
 pair=[]
 for suffix in ('_codes','_scale'):
  key=prefix+projection+'_proj'+suffix
  with safe_open(str(checkpoint/index[key]),framework='pt',device='cpu') as handle:
   pair.append(handle.get_tensor(key))
 codes,scales=pair
 values.append((unpack_canonical_codes(codes,scales.shape[1]*32),scales.float()))
gate=torch.cat([v[0] for v in values[:2]],0)[None]
gs=torch.cat([v[1] for v in values[:2]],0)[None]
down,ds=values[2][0][None],values[2][1][None]
x=torch.randn(2,4096,generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(5704)).half().npu()
gc,dc,ggs,gds=pack_nz_codes(gate,4).npu(),pack_nz_codes(down,4).npu(),gs.npu(),ds.npu()
weights=torch.ones(2,1).npu();order=torch.tensor([0,1],dtype=torch.int64).npu();ends=torch.tensor([2],dtype=torch.int64).npu()
report={'build_options':json.loads((build/'provenance.json').read_text())['_build'],'scope':'one real W4 expert, two synthetic activation rows, prepared routing; device events include native launch intervals','records':[]}
for bits in (8,4):
 native=NativeFusedMoE(build,namespace='glm_reconstruction_v13',activation_bits=bits)
 geometry=FusedGeometry(2,1,1,4096,2048,4,4,bits)
 def pipeline():
  return native.grouped(x,gc,ggs,dc,gds,weights,order,ends,geometry)
 for _ in range(3):
  pipeline()
 torch.npu.synchronize()
 events=[]
 original=native.launch
 names={id(native.pack_kernel):'input_quant_once',id(native.gate_kernel):'gate_up_swiglu_quant',id(native.down_kernel):'down_weighted_reduce'}
 def timed(kernel,args,blocks):
  start,end=torch.npu.Event(enable_timing=True),torch.npu.Event(enable_timing=True)
  start.record()
  original(kernel,args,blocks)
  end.record()
  events.append((names[id(kernel)],start,end))
 native.launch=timed
 try:
  for _ in range(5):
   pipeline()
  torch.npu.synchronize()
 finally:
  native.launch=original
 samples={name:[] for name in names.values()}
 for name,start,end in events:
  samples[name].append(start.elapsed_time(end))
 report['records'].append({'activation_bits':bits,'stage_ms':{name:{'median_ms':statistics.median(ms),'samples_ms':ms} for name,ms in samples.items()}})
(root/'native-fused-v13-stage-events.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
